title: Mixed Event — Time to RE:START! — Episode8 The Path We Choose

meta.Event Outline: Eager to make MORE MORE JUMP! official, Airi and the others waste no time in searching for an agency to join, but...

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks for coming, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No, don't worry about it! But I am wondering why you asked us to come up here...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I was surprised as well since you called so late about wanting to discuss something.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You can all relax a bit, you know.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I finally managed to sort out some ideas I had and I wanted to let you know as soon as I did!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What is it you want to discuss?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, here's the thing. I have a suggestion about how we might be able to move forward.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Move forward... As MORE MORE JUMP!?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yes. Obviously, you all know we've been having trouble with agencies, so I did some thinking.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: How about we ditch the idea of finding a talent agency and become an independent idol group instead?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Like... Freelancing...?
Do you mean that, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, of course I do.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The way things are now, I don't think we're going to find an agency that's gonna be willing to work with us any time soon.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So instead of wasting our time on that, I thought it'd be much better to start doing stuff on our own.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That may be true, but...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's going to be extremely difficult...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: As an independent group, we'd be responsible for handling everything old managers and staff used to handle. Scheduling, meetings, you name it.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Doing all of that while also making the time to practice won't be easy.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
And we won't have a producer.
How will we handle marketing?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I get that it won't be easy.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But I think between the two of us, we'll be able to manage scheduling and marketing.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You and me...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, you're always so organized and you have the most experience out of any of us. I think you'd be great at it.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Of course, I'd be there to help too. I'm not gonna make you handle everything on your own.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: U-Um, is there any way for me to help out? I want to do something, even if it's running random errands!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I would like to do my part as well.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Thanks, you two.
I was already planning on asking.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I actually spent the whole day yesterday researching what QT has done since they first formed. I looked at what shows they've been on, what kind of interviews, everything.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: None of us have any real experience doing that kind of stuff ourselves, so I figured we'd need as much reference material as possible.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well, it's all pretty vague since all I have to go on are whatever schedules and information I could find online.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I also gathered everything I could find on the promotional stuff that was used for a bunch of the idols who recently debuted.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Whoa! That's so much...!
It's bigger than a textbook!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm sure there's still a lot missing, but I think this should be enough to figure out how to market MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Even if we do our own marketing, do you think we'll still get work if we're not part of an agency? How are we going to actually get up on stage to perform?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And if we don't perform, how are the fans going to see us?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: O-Oh! I actually have a suggestion about that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Shizuku's been helping me record some videos!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We only just started, but if it goes well enough, we could upload them to streaming sites! That might help us get exposure even without being on TV!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Recording our own videos...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's a good idea. We can make our own videos without any extra staff on hand...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: After listening to what Airi said, I'm convinced that the four of us can do anything together!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We may not be performing on big stages or popular TV shows yet...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But if we split the work and start doing things our own way, I'm sure people will take notice!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I agree with Minori.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Where we might be doesn't matter. As long as people are able to find us, we'll be able to spread hope.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I know it's going to be tough, but I want to do whatever we can to keep going. I don't want to give up...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: As long as we're together, I believe we can overcome any obstacle.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Minori... Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, you're right. We all decided that we're gonna spread hope to others, didn't we? That means we have to take on whatever challenges that come our way.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
You're right...
There's never just one path.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Airi, thank you for suggesting this.
I... I think I was being a little stubborn.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We have the promotional research Airi put together, and a video-based approach devised by Minori and Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: There's still no way of telling how things will go, but I'll do my best to help however I can.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: If this is the path you all think we should take, then we just gotta figure out how to walk it together.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Let's see... How about we start by taking some practice videos after school today?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori, you and Shizuku could start by teaching us what you've tried so far. Does that sound good?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Sure! I'll put some notes together before then!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Then I should start adding recording days to my calendar.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh! I bet writing Recording Day on my schedule would make me feel more like a real idol!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe! I'm gonna put that in my planner for sure♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
In that case, I'll add it as well.
It'll help get me into the right state of mind.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I'm glad everyone's smiling again...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (An optimistic mindset is key to being an idol. No matter what happens, you keep smiling and never give up.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (So no more looking down! We're going to prove that the four of us have what it takes!)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright! We officially start working today as idols! As MORE MORE JUMP!
